name: Hatsuuso ~Sugarareta Niizuma~
source:
Before they were married, he changed jobs and moved himself and Saki from their condo to a ratty apartment, uprooting them both to pursue his dreams.
Saki said to him, despite his selfishness, "I'm happy just being with you."

He was her everything, and their life seemed without troubles.

That love carried into their marriage, but soon after the relocation something changed.
Work demands brought her husband home later at night, and she spent more and more time with the neighbor...

- A sexually inexperienced new wife falls into the arms of someone other than her husband... She loves him but to whom will she ultimately devote her heart? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE062942.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在他们结婚之前，他换了工作，并把自己和萨基从他们的公寓搬到了一间破旧的公寓，为了追求自己的梦想，他们俩都背井离乡。
尽管他很自私，咲希还是对他说：“和你在一起我就很开心了。”

他就是她的一切，他们的生活似乎没有任何麻烦。

这种爱延续到了他们的婚姻中，但搬迁后不久，情况发生了变化。
工作需要让丈夫晚上回家，她和邻居待在一起的时间也越来越多……

- 缺乏性经验的新婚妻子投入了丈夫以外的人的怀抱……她爱他，但最终她的心会献给谁？
